title: draba oreades var. commutata
intro: Draba oreades var. commutata, commonly known as alpine whitlowgrass, is a type of flowering plant in the mustard family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of alpine whitlowgrass include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, prevent infections, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
